question:
A node of voltage $V_o$ is connected to an input source $V_{in}$ through a resistor $R=1.0\,\text{k}\Omega$ and to ground through $R_L=2.0\,\text{k}\Omega$.

Two silicon diodes (constant drop model, $V_\gamma=0.7\,\text{V}$) are connected as follows:

- Diode $D_1$: anode at $V_o$, cathode at a fixed reference $+3.0\,\text{V}$.
- Diode $D_2$: anode at a fixed reference $-2.0\,\text{V}$, cathode at $V_o$.

Assume the reference sources can supply/absorb any current.

For (i) $V_{in}=+10\,\text{V}$ and (ii) $V_{in}=-10\,\text{V}$, find the clamped value(s) of $V_o$ and the conducting diode current in each case.
